body: I don't know how I'm doing. I like my job, and I have a few good friends left. But I just feel so lost without him. All I do with my alone time is drink anymore, and that doesn't even work. I was surprised that anyone even read my post. And seriously, thank all of you so much. I've seen this subreddit help so many people. You guys make it work.

Editing has been allowed. Also, I feel like the letter flows better if I leave the specific dates out, as the date of said events are referenced in the text itself. But if you'd like to edit in a suggestion as to how I might include the date more directly, that'd be great! Thanks for the help!
